title: Unicode Character Converter & Analyzer
description: Convert text to Unicode code points, HTML entities, binary, hex, and decimal. Analyze character properties and detailed Unicode mappings instantly.

faqs.question: What does this Unicode Converter do?
faqs.answer: It breaks down your text into individual characters (including emojis and surrogate pairs) and details their numeric mappings: Unicode Code Point (U+XXXX), Hexadecimal, Decimal, Binary, and HTML entity representations.

faqs.question: Does it support multi-byte characters and emojis?
faqs.answer: Yes! The tool uses modern JavaScript code point iteration to correctly inspect complex characters, surrogate pairs, and emojis without splitting them.

educationalContent.whatIsIt: A Unicode Converter and Analyzer is an essential utility for developers to inspect character encoding, find escape representations, and resolve formatting issues.
educationalContent.howToUse:
1. Paste your text in the input box.
2. Instantly view the character-by-character detailed table.
3. Choose from various output formats (Hex, Code Point, Entities, Binary) and copy the result.
